title: Dual-Corrected Stochastic Block Model ($\text{DC}^2\text{SBM}$): A Generalized Structure Detection Method for Attributed Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.40676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Community detection in attributed networks is one of the core tasks of complex network analysis. The stochastic block model (SBM) and its variants are able to detect generalized network structures such as assortative, disassortative and mixed structures. However, existing generative methods either ignore node heterogeneity, or characterize node activity in the topological and attribute dimensions by one and the same factor, making it difficult to correctly model node activity when the two kinds of activity are decoupled. In this paper, we propose the Dual-Corrected Stochastic Block Model ($\text{DC}^2\text{SBM}$), which introduces independent correction factors---a topological degree factor and an attribute abundance factor---into the link-generation and attribute-generation channels, respectively, thereby effectively decoupling node activity from membership inference, and which further introduces a global scaling parameter to resolve

translated_title: 双重校正随机块模型（DC²SBM）：一种面向属性网络的广义结构检测方法
translated_abstract: 属性网络中的社区发现是复杂网络分析的核心任务之一。随机块模型（SBM）及其变体能够检测广义的网络结构，如同质结构、异质结构和混合结构。然而，现有的生成式方法要么忽略节点的异质性，要么用同一个因子来刻画节点在拓扑维度和属性维度上的活跃度，导致当这两种活跃度相互解耦时难以正确建模节点活跃度。本文提出了双重校正随机块模型（DC²SBM），该模型在连边生成通道和属性生成通道中分别引入独立的校正因子——拓扑度因子和属性丰度因子，从而有效地将节点活跃度与成员关系推断解耦，并进一步引入全局缩放参数以解决……
tldr: 提出双重校正随机块模型DC²SBM，通过在连边生成和属性生成通道中分别引入独立的拓扑度因子和属性丰度因子，实现节点活跃度与成员关系推断的解耦，从而有效检测属性网络中的广义结构。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Dual-Corrected Stochastic Block Model (DC²SBM), which decouples node activity from membership inference by introducing independent topological degree and attribute abundance correction factors into the link-generation and attribute-generation channels respectively, enabling generalized structure detection in attributed networks.
